title: Smart Alerting System
user_story: As an SRE, I want to receive alerts only for critical anomalies so that I avoid alert fatigue.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Pod in CrashLoopBackOff state, trigger a CRITICAL alert immediately.
Given high CPU usage (>80%) for less than 5 minutes, DO NOT trigger an alert (transient spike).
Given a node in NotReady state, trigger a WARNING alert.
tech_constraints: Must output alerts in JSON format
